svg.title: CaveScript32 inscription (47 cells)
svg.desc: Rendered with CaveScript32 sign drawings by Michael S. Moniz (CC BY 4.0), https://suposystem.ai/cavescript/. Read each cell left sign then right sign; cells left to right, rows top to bottom.
